post.title: South Korea went from $158 a person in 1960 to $36,239 in 2024. Here's how.
post.ig: In 1960, South Korea made just $158 per person. By 2024: $36,239. Here's how it became a tech giant.
post.tiktok: South Korea went from $158 per person to passing Japan. How one country did it in one lifetime.
post.yt_desc:
In 1960, South Korea produced about $158 per person, according to the World Bank. By 2024 it was $36,239, and Japan's own data shows Korea passed Japan per person in 2023. This video explains how: postwar aid, the 1962 economic plan and the export push, heavy industry, the 1997 crash and the gold drive, and the rise of Samsung and SK hynix in memory chips. Then we follow it to your wallet: Korean cars, TVs, phones and K-beauty, the 2025 US-Korea tariff deal, and Korean factories in Georgia and Texas. By October 2026, Korea's exports for the year had reached about $930 billion, led by chips.
